notes.title: Major Patch #9
notes.content:
[h1]We are back with updates![/h1]

The Patch #9 is now live and features [b]a lot[/b] of changes!! We have re-designed how the player reacts with the interactable items and searchable components of the environment. We have improved the loading times and overall performance of the game. You can find the full list of changes below.

[b]** IMPORTANT**[/b]
In order to add some features we had to make some core changes to the game which unfortunately means that your previously saved games might not work. We have to get through these stages in order to make Westwood Shadows a good game. We apologize for any inconvenience and we appreciate all your help with the game.


[h2]Fixed - Changed[/h2]
- Settings: Added "Cinematic" as the higher quality option for graphics.
- Settings: Disabled the auto-detect functionality which caused problems on some users
- Settings: "Epic" is now the default quality for graphics.
- Settings: There are now more advanced options available under graphics tab, so each player can tweak, based on computer specs.
- Gameplay: Fixed a bug that caused some cut-scenes to appear blurry
- Gameplay: The default interaction key switched from "left mouse click" to "E"
- Gameplay: Removed unnecessary drawers / closets interactions.
- Gameplay: Save/Load system has been improved to reduce significantly loading times
- Gameplay: Improved collision detection system due to unforeseen collision glitches that caused the player to fall out of map
- Gameplay: The valves from the basement puzzle now return to inventory after use. 
- Gameplay: Flashlight now turns off when interacting with a keypad and turns back on at the end of the interaction
- Gameplay: Fixed a bug that allowed the player to pause the game wile loading a new game
- Puzzles: A redesign of puzzles has been implemented to improve the communication of the puzzles' goal
- UI: Player can exit from all UI panels using the ESC button. 
- UI: Fixed a bug that caused the wrong subtitle to appear when using a wrong item on a lock or puzzle
- UI: Fixed a bug that caused Save Games to display incorrect time.
- Audio:  Fixed a bug that caused some Sound effects and Ambient sounds to playing at the wrong volume.
- Audio: Ambient sound can now be controlled from the menu screen under Audio Settings
- Map changes: New improved overall lighting
- Map changes: Optimized lighting in certain areas of the map that lighting didn't have the desired effect.
- Map changes: Optimized mesh actors that were causing collision glitches and performance issues.
- Map changes: Optimized and added new textures quality for low, medium and high settings.
- Map changes: Optimized basement lanterns that were causing random frame drops
- Map changes: Updated steam effects

[h2]Added[/h2]
- Gameplay: There is now a completely new interaction system that helps the player identify points of interest and items.
- Gameplay: The new interaction system features an icon that will switch to the input key required to press in order to interact. This icon will reflect any changes made from the key-binding menu. 
- Gameplay: A new targeting system was created based on "proximity aiming" rather than "precision aiming". Drawers closets and doors can now be interacted with a key without having to aim directly at the drawer.
- Gameplay: A new system that enables the game to load and unload certain areas was created for optimization on loading times and game performance.
- Gameplay: Created a system that gives the player the ability to inspect journal and inventory items again after pick up
- UI: Player's HUD is now updated with information every time the player picks up an item. It is now showing whether it is going to inventory or journal.


[h2]What to expect in the next patch:[/h2]
We aim to improve all user interfaces (UI) soon while working on user interactions and game performance. We are also now working on adding controller functionality and we might have it ready for the next patch.


As we are getting closer to better functionality with better performance and player interactions we will continue to listen to your feedback and improve the overall gaming experience.  

Join our community:
[url=https://discord.gg/Sn2tXWsckQ][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41142167/809cc06d8c23dac08eb8ce927bf6786048582489.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41142167/1ffd3dec141e6e3318c0663e3e2348d32d20d673.png[/img][/url][/url]

Thank you,
Eleftherios from RedSoup

notes.title: Major Patch #8
notes.content:
In this patch we have fixed a lot of the game settings issues and we have enabled some of the previously disabled (greyed out) options including the following:

Fixed:
- Fixed an issue that caused Loading to freeze the game for a long period.
- Fixed an issue that caused main menu and the game to blur.
- Fixed an issue when the "save overwrite" menu would get stuck on screen.
- Fixed an issue that was causing "player to pin keypad" interaction to be instant.
- Fixed an issue that caused inventory to need an extra click to interact with the mouse.

Added:
- A default button for Controls under Settings.
- A default button for Gameplay under Settings.
- A default button for Brightness under Gameplay settings.
- Enabled FOV (Field of view) setting.
- Enabled Camera Sensitivity setting.
- Enabled Reverse Camera setting.
- Esc key now closes all menus except from Key Binding menu.

For some of the above settings to take effect we had to make a new file name for the system settings of the game which may erase previous saved files. In case you lost any progress please respond with a comment or write us a message under Discussions in the Community hub and we will help you retrieve your files.

We are also on discord! You can send us your feedback there and discuss further about anything you need!
[url=https://discord.gg/Sn2tXWsckQ][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41142167/da286a9d75fd54f3c09ca96241030de36ae8e085.png[/img][/url]

Thank you
RedSoup team

notes.title: Major Patch 4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41142167/a138e9c3c2d4db7947431379cc56e77ff5ac63ca.png[/img]

In this patch, we have redesigned the way the flashlight works. 

- From now on when the flashlight runs out of battery and the player has no extra batteries to reload, there is an emergency mode which allows the player to turn on the flashlight for a limited time. The light might flicker and have lower intensity but it is enough to navigate and search for more batteries.

- The original intensity, duration, and cone angle of the flashlight have been increased for better and longer lighting time.

- The batteries and save coins around the playable areas have been increased.

- There are now save phones near all the puzzles so the player can pause and save the progress.

We are in the process of making tutorials for the new system as well as some extra tweaks. 

We are also on discord! You can send us your feedback there and discuss further about anything you need!
[url=https://discord.gg/Sn2tXWsckQ][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41142167/da286a9d75fd54f3c09ca96241030de36ae8e085.png[/img][/url]

Thank you
RedSoup team

notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
In this patch we have fixed some major issues with the settings of the game. Previously when the player changed some specific settings the game would become blurry. This is now totally fixed.

We have also added a brightness set on the first time the player is launching the game in order to make sure the game shows as intended. 

So far we still have some tasks of the previous list we published. We focused on bugs and errors this time.

[list]
[*] A section under the game menu will be added which will include all tutorials.
[*] A tutorial on how to unlock doors by using the keys from the inventory will be added.
[*] An indication for the remaining battery of the flashlight will be added.
[*] The player will be able to close all menus by pressing ESC.
[*] Controller functionality is still under development.
[*] Announced languages will be added in a patch close to the game's completion.
[*] Some of the settings in-game are disabled. They will be completed in one of the following patches.
[*] Steam Achievements will be added.
[*] Inspection of all picked-up items will be added.
[*] More interaction with the environment.
[/list]

Best wishes,
RedSoup team

notes.title: Launching the Prologue for Westwood Shadows
notes.content:
We are very excited to share with you the prologue for the upcoming title: Westwood Shadows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41142167/039a6215a49e205296efe2034f35834aaa8e7814.jpg[/img]

Our small indie team has worked really hard to cover all the aspects we wanted to have ready for this small piece of Westwood Shadows. The full version of the game will include extra features such as enemy encounters, combat and more!

We count on you to share your thoughts and feedback to make Westwood Shadows even better.
Feel free to use the following form if you want to help us improve the game.

ːsteamthumbsupː [url=https://forms.gle/hrTCK8jsu2stAhiQ6]Feedback Form on Google[/url]

Below you can find a list of known issues and things we want to improve:

[list]
[*] A section under the game menu will be added which will include all tutorials.
[*] A tutorial on how to unlock doors by using the keys from the inventory will be added.
[*] An indication for the remaining battery of the flashlight will be added.
[*] The player will be able to close all menus by pressing ESC.
[*] Controller functionality is still under development.
[*] Announced languages will be added in a patch close to the game's completion.
